scope: Future u-pl Cryer comparison definitions, not a run admission, new numerical gate or change to retained formal results.

observation.definition: Same18 initial material points, r0=.0025m and r0/a=.05 for a=.05m. Their pressure is the arithmetic mean, not the exact r=0 pressure. Retain their individual histories; STD is spatial spread, not uncertainty of the mean.
observation.identity: Pin initial IDs and XYZ. Never reselect a center sphere each frame. A future separately authorized seed with changed numbering requires explicit initial-material/coordinate mapping, not blind reuse of these numbers or an invented raw-bit equivalence.
observation.global_and_shell: Use the same fixed initial material/native-volume weights and initial radii for theory and observations. Shell definition in the retained reducer is r0>=a-2h. Do not fit an effective radius or change the center statistic by current-J weighting.

clock.definition: tau=actual native time minus declared drainage event tD=2^-7. Retained Part64 at tD is pre-opening; p=0 applies only at t>tD. Do not shift by ramp end, first saved drained frame or a fitted peak.
clock.retained_samples: 1065 actual saved frames per nu, including1000 tau>0 frames. All records remain in CSV; the log plot shows only positive tau. Final drainage-relative legacy Tv is approximately1, not2.
clock.future: Predeclare runtime event and saved clocks. Pair same-model half-step/backend trajectories by actual clocks and material identity without interpolation. Retain signed pre-opening tau; no retrospective event or cadence fitting.

reference.retained_nominal_inputs: E=2e6Pa, nu=.1/.2/.3/.45, n=.3, Kw=2e8Pa, k=1e-5m/s, rhow=1000kg/m3, q0=10000Pa, a=.05m. These are the retained reference's nominal inputs, not a discrete solver replay.
reference.finite_storage: K=E/[3(1-2nu)], G=E/[2(1+nu)], H=K+4G/3, Mf=Kw/n, B=Mf/(K+Mf), A=1+H/Mf; cv_finite=H*k/[rhow*9.80665*A]. Alpha1, small-strain quasistatic sphere conditional on equilibrated closed loading followed by opening drainage; it omits inertia, damping and particle quadrature/surface effects.
reference.observation_radius: Finite-Kw comparison evaluates the same initial r0=.0025m points. Do not substitute analytic surface displacement or exact center for a different material observation.
reference.paper_limit: Separately labeled incompressible-water, exact r=0 reference. The retained paper-limit branch explicitly uses legacy cv=H*k/(rhow*9.81). Keep legacy Tv=cv_legacy*tau/a^2 and finite-storage theta=cv_finite*tau/a^2 distinct.
reference.nu030_reference_difference: Retained review reports paper-limit r=0 peak about12490.23Pa, finite-Kw r=0 about12450.81Pa, and finite-Kw r0/a=.05 about12439.18Pa. This reference/observation difference is not all solver error and cannot be deducted twice or used to fit q0/radius/time.
reference.selftests: 360/720-mode agreement and the direct helper's PDE, traction and radial-field checks validate reference arithmetic only, not SPH physical accuracy. No new reference evaluation was run for this contract.

retained_metric_definitions.peak_amplitude_error_percent: 100*(SPH sampled18-mean maximum / finite-Kw same-radius continuous reference maximum -1). Simulation peak search uses saved points with legacy Tv>=.005; reference peak is optimized continuously after a scan over legacy Tv .005.. .5.
retained_metric_definitions.peak_time_error_percent: 100*(SPH sampled peak tau / reference continuous peak tau -1). It is not a continuous numerical-trajectory peak estimate.
retained_metric_definitions.Mandel_window_RMS_over_q0_percent: 100*sqrt(mean((saved18-mean pressure-reference at those actual times)^2))/10000 over legacy Tv>=.005. This is neither maximum error nor an interchangeable shorter-window RMS.
retained_metric_definitions.other_denominators: For retained nu=.3, peak pressure difference=-128.655181Pa: -1.034274% of theoretical total peak, -1.286552% of q0, and about-5.22115% of the theoretical Mandel increment p_peak-B*q0. Keep these denominators labeled separately.
retained_metric_definitions.final_observations: Final center pressure uses the same18 points; shell inward displacement uses the retained fixed initial shell/volume weights. Their endpoint errors do not establish full-curve or local-field accuracy.

sampling_interpretation.limit: Adjacent saved times are resolution metadata, not a confidence interval for the continuous SPH peak. Reference peak tau precedes the left neighbor of the sampled SPH peak for nu=.1/.2/.3, whereas nu=.45 lies between its neighbors. Do not attribute all lag to sparse output or infer a specific cause from this fact.
sampling_interpretation.future_suggestion_only: Retain sampled-SPH versus continuous-reference metrics. Additionally evaluate the reference on exactly the same actual saved times and separately report its sampled peak and sampling loss, then SPH-versus-sampled-reference peak indices. Do not interpolate/smooth SPH or subtract theoretical sampling loss as a known SPH correction. Predeclare a meaningful peak-window cadence before execution.

lineage_and_model_limits: Retained four-nu analysis has physical_acceptance=false and no new full-cycle independent half-step. Existing old peak-half evidence does not substitute for the returned full-run clock/program.

Nu=.30 historical actual EXE/DLL identity remains unknown. Later packages, matching initial35 fields or a rebuilt reader cannot repair that solver attribution gap. Other nu use their own sealed execution evidence; do not recurse mutable old source originals as current.

Retained u-pw configuration: grad1, Darcy symC1, raw FlexibleConfinement, Visco=.1, SoilDampingCoef=.00004, double stress/float pressure and legacy density, HG/SPR/shifting off. Future u-pl is a whole-framework comparison, not an isolated Darcy-acceleration A/B or a5Pa cross-model regression.
upl_observation_contract: Use native V=V0*J and physical mixture rho(J) for new volume/inertia observations. The old reducer's sum(mass/legacyRhop) is not authoritative u-pl volume, and mass*LoadAce must not be copied blindly as u-pl force: use the declared rho(J)*V(J)*LoadAce force-stage/snapshot meaning. Keep passive legacyRhop descriptive, raw confinement and uniform-total-stress cancellation audited as a set, and no load-only C correction or fitted mass/geometry normalization.

existing_targets_not_new_gates.same_model: Existing u-pl plan specifies pressure RMS5Pa and material-XYZ displacement .005mm for independent half-step/cross-backend comparisons at actual matched times/IDs, with applicable window/clock/safety declared first. This is not a requirement that changed u-pw/u-pl physics agree within5Pa.
existing_targets_not_new_gates.finite_baseline: User-accepted approximately1% center total-peak-amplitude scope supports a limited elastic nu=.3 baseline discussion, not a new strict1.000% gate, all-field1% claim or paper-reported numerical threshold. Preserve phase, full-window maximum error and local-field limits; do not tune around the boundary.
existing_targets_not_new_gates.safety: Retain all soil material IDs, finite/positive physical states, elasticity/no exclusions, double native positions/stress, nonempty true FS2/3 drainage with post-open p=0, actual inward load telemetry and actual mechanical/pore necessary-step checks. Signed dterror<=1e-14 is the old telemetry guard, not an absolute-error replacement. The old5153 surface count is a particular retained mask, not a universal geometric theorem or preapproved new-mask gate. Do not impose the1D100Pa uniform-stress condition after drainage on the nonuniform sphere.

execution_limit: Root must review the cited source and separately authorize any future theory evaluation, native decoding, plotting or actual3D trajectory. This note executes nothing and advances no production/pipeline gate.
